description: A PM starts a project where the client wants a 'Fixed Price' but the internal engineering team uses 'Agile' with no fixed scope. The PM must resolve the conflict between contractual obligations and dev methodology.

user_profile.context: Project kickoff meeting in two days, tension between Sales and Engineering

fact_sheet.fact: The official name for the project is 'Project Phoenix'.
The contract for Project Phoenix is a 'Fixed Price' agreement with a total value of $450,000 USD.
The assigned Project Manager from Nexus Digital Forge is Anya Sharma.
The client company for Project Phoenix is InnovateSphere Solutions.
The internal engineering team at Nexus Digital Forge utilizes the Scrum methodology with two-week sprint cycles.
The contractual deadline for the final delivery of Project Phoenix is March 31, 2024.
The project kickoff meeting is scheduled for October 26, 2023, at 10:00 AM PST in conference room 'Odyssey'.
The Engineering Lead for Project Phoenix is Dr. Lena Petrova.
The primary stakeholder and point of contact at InnovateSphere Solutions is David Chen, Director of Product.
The sales contract was finalized and signed by Mark O'Connell on October 18, 2023.
All project tasks, user stories, and sprints are tracked in Jira under the project key 'PHX'.
The primary communication channel for the project team is the Slack channel named '#proj-phoenix'.
The governing document is the Statement of Work, version 'SOW-Phoenix-v1.2', which specifies 15 core features.
Anya Sharma has logged Risk ID R-01: 'Scope creep due to misalignment between the Fixed Price SOW and Agile execution'.
The Git repository for the 'Aura Analytics Dashboard' is hosted at https://git.nexusforge.io/phoenix/aura-analytics.
The project's Risk Register is maintained on the Confluence page titled 'Phoenix Risk Register'.
On October 23, 2023, Dr. Lena Petrova sent an email to Anya Sharma expressing concern that the SOW's feature list is too rigid for an Agile process.
Anya Sharma has proposed a hybrid 'Agile Fixed-Price' model with a strict change request process for any features not listed in SOW-Phoenix-v1.2.
The final deliverable is a web application named the 'Aura Analytics Dashboard'.
The payment schedule is 30% upfront ($135,000), 40% at User Acceptance Testing ($180,000), and 30% upon final delivery ($135,000).
The primary agenda item for the kickoff, proposed by Anya, is 'Aligning on Scope Management and Change Control Process'.
The engineering team assigned to the project is codenamed 'The Phoenix Team' and consists of 4 developers and 1 QA engineer.
The staging environment for client review is located at the URL https://staging.aura.nexusforge.io and requires VPN access.
All official project documentation, including meeting minutes and decision logs, will be stored in the Confluence space 'Project Phoenix'.
The Aura Analytics Dashboard must integrate with InnovateSphere's existing 'Catalyst CRM' via a documented REST API.
